author_role: provider_rows; theory author, not independent reviewer

authority.parallel_owner_scope: existing authority survey reused; no external consumer implementation adopted

stages.R3: Explicit source/native versus declared model identities, units, state domains and admission ceilings specified.
stages.R4: State vector, source-native aggregate, and prescribed positive lift compared; implementation should require an explicit lift rather than default LTE.

assumptions.statement: Finite nonempty state family I; all quantities finite; fixed temperature/external parameters.
x_i>=0 are physical state number densities in cm^-3; X=sum_i x_i.
Known d_i>=0 in cm^3 s^-1 refer to the same reaction, collider, state labels and normalization.
h>=0 is the physical collider density in cm^-3; scalar iff theorem additionally requires h>0.
pi_i>=0 and sum_i pi_i=1. For all-state scalar closure pi is prescribed independently of hidden x.
Scalar iff and full ker(P) necessity use the entire nonnegative state cone. Restricted domains require only their admissible same-projection differences.
Formation theorem requires b_i>=0, sum_i b_i=1 over a specified product family with common isotope/charge/electron composition. Actual b is not supplied by current source.
Declared number model selects H=1H, D=2H, Li=7Li. Source7Li is explicit; source H mass number and nuclear isomer remain unspecified. Model isomer g is a convention, not source-rate qualification.
tau is proper time in seconds, densities are physical cm^-3, reference density is positive and its derivative must be included if nonzero.

claims.statement: The seven-material-species by six-source-variant matrix preserves each modeled isotope nucleus, charge and total bound/free electron-lepton number.

claims.assumption: Count each atom, molecule, ion and free electron once; exclude photons. Immediate thermal assimilation is not asserted.

claims.rate_units: R:events cm^-3 s^-1; j:s^-1 per reference particle
claims.clock: proper time seconds; coordinate clock conversion supplied by consumer
claims.identical_incoming_factor: 1 for every current variant because reactants are distinct
claims.reference_derivative_may_be_dropped_only: the relevant contribution to n_ref derivative vanishes

claims.zero_population_case: X=0 implies x=0, J=J_pi=0; no division by X required

claims.proof: r=x-pi*X satisfies1^T r=0; subtract c1 with c=(dmax+dmin)/2; apply triangle inequality and max norm.

requires: prescribed pi independent of hidden x
claims.proof: Test x=X0*e_i with X0>0 for necessity; substitute constant d for sufficiency; e_i-e_j spans zero-sum directions.
exceptions: h=0 makes both fluxes zero without constraining d
On x=pi X only, arbitrary d is exact
Setting pi=x/X requires the hidden population and is not scalar closure

claims.formula: d^T x depends only on P x for all x>=0 iff d annihilates ker(P) iff d^T=dbar^T P
claims.proof: For necessity decompose z in ker(P) as zplus-zminus; both are nonnegative and have equal P-image. For sufficiency define the induced linear functional on im(P).
claims.restriction: For a restricted admissible domain use only same-P admissible differences; no universal positive lift for arbitrary P asserted.

requirements: all product states share material conserved composition

claims.positivity_proof: All coefficient factors and Bennett denominator terms are positive on T>0.
